programme.title: Most Daring
programme.desc: Tonight, on Most Daring ... from Bonnie and Clyde wannabes ... to best buddies gone bad ... perps pair off ... in Dangerous Duos! True stories of real people ... in real danger! This is, Most Daring – DANGEROUS DUOS!
